title: A real campaign can send to past customers and has its own renamable groups
steps: Run the campaign settings and send ledger suites against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL) from this branch.
expect: A CSV whose group column holds only non-baseline values gives the campaign those values as groups; one baseline value keeps the baseline five and a typo answers unknown_group.
POST /campaigns/:id/settings sets audience and group names and refuses an unknown audience, a group the campaign does not have, an empty or over-long name and a stale revision.
A past_customers campaign sends to a customer aMember says has no plan; aMember failing still answers REAL_MEMBERSHIP_UNKNOWN; an active_plan campaign still answers REAL_NOT_MEMBER.
fence: Private test database only; no mailbox, no customer address.

tests: a CSV with its own group values makes the campaign groups
a baseline CSV keeps the five baseline groups
settings set the audience and rename groups
a campaign for past customers invites a customer with no plan
